# Will your glamping site pay for itself? Payback, debt coverage and break-even occupancy

> Free payback calculator for glamping and cabin sites: build cost, shared infrastructure, seasonal nightly rates and occupancy, commission, turnovers and a loan become operating income, debt coverage, cash after the loan, payback in years and break-even occupancy. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
